question: Does restoring the original expected number of samples per previously trained game improve their held imitation when adding TH11?
metrics: Analyze all four arms and all five titles. Report actual game/rank draws, all-direction accuracy, turns, and equal-player movement NLL. The 3750-update five-title arm expects 48000 draws per game, matching the 3000-update four-title arm. The long four-title arm controls for total additional optimization. The same development players informed the hypothesis. This study only measures expert imitation.
